title: 12 Best Cafes & Coffee Shops in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's best cafes, from minimalist third-wave coffee shops to traditional kissaten, perfect for every budget and taste. Find your next favorite brew in Shibuya, Shinjuku, and beyond.

places.name: Fuglen Tokyo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic espresso or filter coffee, showcasing their rotating single-origin beans. Don't miss their cocktails in the evening.

places.name: Omotesando Koffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Koffee Kashi' (custard cube) alongside a perfectly crafted cappuccino or iced latte.

places.name: Blue Bottle Coffee Shinjuku
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic pour-over coffee, or try their New Orleans-style Iced Coffee for a unique treat.

places.name: Sarutahiko Coffee Ebisu Flagship
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'Ebisu Blend' drip coffee or a rich cafe latte. Don't forget their delightful baked goods.

places.name: Cafe Kitsuné Aoyama
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A beautifully presented matcha latte or a strong espresso. Their fox-shaped shortbread cookies are adorable.

places.name: THE ROASTERY by NOZY COFFEE
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pour-over of their daily single-origin selection. Ask the barista for their current recommendations based on your taste.

places.name: Streamer Coffee Company Shibuya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Streamer Latte' for a visual and flavorful treat, or the 'Rebel Blend' drip coffee if you like it strong.

places.name: Doutor Coffee Shop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A simple 'Blended Coffee' and their 'Milan Sandwich' for a classic Doutor experience.

places.name: Komeda's Coffee Shinjuku Higashiguchi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Komeda Blend Coffee' with the complimentary toast during morning hours. Also try the 'Shiro-Noir' dessert.

places.name: L'Eclair de Genie Ginza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair a strong espresso or latte with any of their visually stunning and delicious éclairs, which are true works of art.

places.name: Verve Coffee Roasters Shinjuku NEWoMan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'The 1950's' blend drip coffee or a refreshing iced americano.

places.name: Bear Pond Espresso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Dirty' espresso (if available and you meet the criteria!) or a standard espresso shot to appreciate his craft.
